error.forbidden: Your account can’t change playlists yet.
error.invalid: That change doesn’t fit this playlist. Reload and try again.
error.notFound: That playlist or snapshot no longer exists.
error.hiddenItems: The playlist has local files or unavailable tracks Rewind can’t see. This change would delete them, so nothing was changed.
error.stale: The playlist changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.
error.failed: The change didn’t go through. Nothing was changed; try again.

outcome.partialTitle: Only part of the change went through
outcome.partialItems: The playlist may hold part of the change. Nothing is lost: a snapshot from before was saved.
outcome.partialSources: The merge worked, but only {done} of {total} source playlists were deleted.
outcome.partialPlaylists: Created {done} of {total} playlists before an error. The original playlist is unchanged.
outcome.restoreFailed: Restoring didn’t work. Try again from History & undo.
outcome.undone: Undone. The previous track list is back.

previewError.forbidden: Your account can’t change playlists yet.

duplicates.title: Remove duplicates

hint.exact: Only the same Spotify track twice.
hint.recording: Same ISRC: the same recording released on different albums.
hint.titleAllArtists: Same title and the same artists. Notes like “Remastered”, “Live” or “feat.” are ignored.
hint.titleSharedArtist: Same title and at least one shared artist. Notes like “Remastered” are ignored.
hint.title: Same title only. Loose: check every group.

compare.pickBody: Tracks both playlists have show up here, with how closely they match.
compare.errorBody: Spotify didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
compare.emptyTitle: No shared tracks at this strictness
compare.emptyBody: Try a looser match to catch remasters and alternate releases.
compare.readOnly: This playlist is read-only, so its tracks can't be removed.

compare.found: {count, plural, one {# track in {name} is also in {other}} other {# tracks in {name} are also in {other}}}
